event.title: Céline Dion Arrives in Paris for Comeback Concerts Amid Health Challenges
event.canonical_title: Céline Dion Arrives in Paris for Comeback Concerts Amid Health Challenges
event.summary: Céline Dion has returned to Paris, where she is set to launch a 16-show arena residency, marking her first major concert series since announcing her diagnosis with Stiff Person Syndrome, an incurable autoimmune disorder. Fans greeted her warmly outside her hotel as she prepares for the sold-out performances.
